samples.conclusion: Multiple tariff IDs represent charging-mode choices, not documented peak/off-peak clock windows. Use default REGULAR for ordinary price; do not choose CHEAP solely as a minimum.
Parking fee is stated per hour. Charging and idle components describe separate states; do not sum both at once. Pricing-unit normalization still needs verification before runtime use.
